titleEnglish: Tere Qurban Pyaare Muhammad ﷺ — Traditional

verses.ar:
Tere qurban pyare Mohammed
Gir raha hoon mujhe bhi sambhalo
verses.en:
I sacrifice myself for you, beloved Muhammad ﷺ
I am falling — hold me, save me

verses.ar:
Apne pyare nawaso ka sadqa
Ya nabi meri jholi mein daalo
verses.en:
For the sake of your beloved grandchildren
O Prophet, place (blessings) into my vessel

verses.ar:
Koi apna nahi roze mehshar
He yaha nafso nafsi ka aalam
Ham ghunahgaar hai ya Mohammed
Apni kamli mein hamko chupalo
verses.en:
On the Day of Judgement no one will be there for another
Every soul will be crying out for itself
We are sinners, O Muhammad
Hide us beneath your black shawl

verses.ar:
Noor se noor milne chala hai
Mustafa se khuda keh raha hai
Ye hai miraj ki raat pyare
Aapne chehre se parda hataalo
verses.en:
Light is moving to meet light
God is calling out to Mustafa
This is the night of Miraj, beloved
Lift the veil from your blessed face

verses.ar:
Dur ho jayenge sab andhere
Noor hi noor ankhon mein hoga
Dekhna hai agar unka jalwa
Apne dil ko madina banalo
verses.en:
All darkness will fade away
There will be nothing but light before your eyes
If you wish to behold his radiance
Make your heart into Madina
